topic: Data transfer and dashboard display issues
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered technical difficulties related to data handling and visualization within the sandbox environment. One participant struggled with exporting 16,000 records from `demographic_data` using their IDE, noting that it would freeze or enter an infinite loop.

Regarding dashboard display, a second issue was noted: content (specifically demographics) does not fit correctly on the page. It was suggested that either custom permissions or adjustments were needed to fix the width/design issues. The goal of displaying demographic data on the traffic page was discussed, though design challenges remain.
decisions: The participant successfully copied data from `demographic_data_1` on the sandbox environment in 8 seconds.
